data.body:
[P2] Revisit the duplicated test setup under Rule 2

This adds another `RunnerCallbacks` and HTTP delivery implementation alongside the equivalent bridge in `agentcore_worker_composed_test.py`. The description acknowledges copying the setup but does not explain which simpler options were considered and why they do not work, as Rule 2 (“Simplify before you add”), item 5 requires. Separate implementations can drift in their callback and transport behavior. Please return to the design phase under Rule 8, step 6, and consider sharing the existing bridge, documenting why duplication is necessary if that remains the chosen approach.
